name: Katsuragi Shion
source:
A beautiful girl of dignified appearance. She is a daughter of the founder of Katsuragi-group, a rich financial conglomerate.
She is the very picture of an honor student, good at both the literary and military arts. She has earnest personality with strong sense of justice. Stubborn and brave, she speaks directly regardless of who is in front of her.
She has been training bushido from the young age, and now is attached to the school's naginata club.
She worries a lot about her younger brother Rindou.
